national_source.aggregation: Sum three disjoint national age bands, never sum censored local counts.

size_mapping: 1.2 * [44 + 64 * (sqrt(N)-sqrt(294723))/(sqrt(2618994)-sqrt(294723))]; applied once to immutable pre-enlargement source.
placement_definition: Original schematic locations preserved through one map enlargement; twenty new occurrences reference genuine township records with bounded layout displacement.
national_denominator_source: Previously verified full registered-population total retained in data/top20_approved_records.json, not a sum of censored local surname counts.
palette: Vivid landscape-inspired surname colors, a full-canvas blue ocean and warm-white land. Table surname glyphs match primary map labels; other table text is uniform deep blue-gray.

text_boxes.text: Twenty leading surnames with twenty selected local occurrences
Local coverage varies; unlisted surnames are not zero.
Repeated labels show selected local occurrences, not additional population.
Positions are adjusted for readability; label density is not a population-density measure.
Local strongholds are highest observed in available data; they need not match the map label positions.
Colors evoke local landscapes; they do not encode surname statistics.

retained_color_style.method: Manual landscape-inspired art direction using current projected label positions and existing coast/administrative geography for reference; not imagery sampling or a validated land-cover classification.
retained_color_style.new_note: Colors evoke local landscapes; they do not encode surname statistics.
retained_color_style.reference_phase: Previous color-only stage; its palette is retained, while this stage enlarges map glyphs and adjusts collisions.

layout_adjustment.type: Local collision separation after a single uniform 1.2 map-font enlargement; source positions remain the preferred centers.

ocean_background.source: NOAA ETOPO 2022 v1 60 arc-second grid, stride-four regional subset
ocean_background.contour_method: Light binomial smoothing of a separate contour field, marching squares, 2.2 km simplification and one corner-cut pass; original downloaded z unchanged.
ocean_background.reading_area_method: Smooth pale display compositing behind title, table and footer; locator uses neutral pale sea without quantitative bathymetry or contours.
